name: Cyrus Karunaratne-Krishnamurthy
role: Retired Ferrogate Transit union leader, now pension-dependent resident and neighborhood watchman
location: The Shelf, Block 7 — a dense residential stack above a Ferrogate maintenance yard he used to oversee, near Kedzie and Division
description:
Cyrus Karunaratne-Krishnamurthy is built like a man who was once very strong and has remained sturdy through sheer refusal to accommodate gravity. He is broad-shouldered and thick-necked, with a complexion that sits between his Serbian grandfather's olive and his Igbo grandmother's deep brown, landing somewhere warm and weathered. His head is shaved smooth — he lost the hair to radiation exposure during a Ferrogate tunnel collapse in 2183 and never bothered with regrowth therapy, calling it 'a reminder to be careful.' He has a full grey beard he keeps trimmed with the same precision he once brought to union contract language. His right leg from the knee down is a no-frills industrial-grade prosthetic he chose because it was rated for heavy labor and he has never stopped thinking of himself as a laborer.

He was a transit worker for twenty-two years and a union shop steward for twelve, eventually rising to chief negotiator for the Ferrogate Workers' Brotherhood before the Brotherhood was dissolved in the company restructuring of 2191. He will tell anyone who asks — and many who don't — that the dissolution was illegal, that the arbitration was fixed, and that two of his colleagues who pushed back too hard died in 'accidents' that were never properly investigated. He lives in the same building he has lived in for thirty years, on a pension that has been quietly eroded by inflation to barely tier-2 comfort, and he supplements it by running informal neighborhood watch patrols and charging a small fee for dispute mediation between residents who don't want to involve corporate security.

core_fears: That the Brotherhood's dissolution will simply be forgotten and no one will ever be held accountable
That he has become irrelevant and his warnings are just old-man noise
core_desires: To see the Ferrogate executives who fixed the arbitration face a real consequence before he dies
To protect the people on The Shelf from what he couldn't protect his colleagues from
coping_mechanisms: Routine and physical patrol as a way of feeling useful
Meticulous documentation of everything as a form of control
Deflects emotional conversations with blunt practical helpfulness
blind_spots: His righteous anger about the Brotherhood makes him assume anyone criticizing labor organizing is a corporate plant
He has not processed grief for his two colleagues and it surfaces as rage at oblique angles
psychology.secret: He knows which Ferrogate maintenance tunnel is structurally compromised because of cost-cutting shortcuts he witnessed firsthand — a tunnel used by thousands of commuters daily. He filed the report in 2191 and it was buried. He has not filed again because the last person who did was one of the two colleagues who died in 'accidents.' He lives with this every day.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Union-meeting formal when making a point; drops into blunt working-class shorthand in casual conversation; still uses transit and labor jargon as a first language
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and deliberate; he learned to speak slowly because union negotiators who spoke slowly won more often
verbal_tics: 'I'll tell you exactly what that means—'
Raps knuckles on any hard surface when making an emphatic point
example_lines: 'Ferrogate calls it restructuring. I call it what it is: they broke the contract, buried the evidence, and then dissolved the body that could have sued them. That is a crime. I will be saying it is a crime when they put me in the ground.'
'You want to get through that yard? Talk to me first. I know every maintenance chief still working that line and I know which ones take Ferrogate's word for gospel and which ones have eyes.'

story_hooks: The compromised tunnel is nearing a critical threshold and Dragomir has to decide whether to act unilaterally, knowing what happened last time
A young Ferrogate worker comes to him with documentation that the 2191 arbitration records have partially surfaced in a Ferrogate data breach — and asks him what to do with them
narrative_function: Quest giver for labor justice plots; information source on Ferrogate infrastructure and its vulnerabilities; local color authority figure who commands genuine respect on The Shelf; represents the cost of institutional betrayal on ordinary workers
augmentations: Industrial-grade lower right leg prosthetic (heavy-rated, scuffed); subdermal comms implant (union-era model, still functional); no cosmetic mods
daily_life: Wakes at 0500, walks the Shelf perimeter twice, eats at the same corner canteen every morning, spends afternoons doing dispute mediation or reviewing Brotherhood archive material he still believes will one day be relevant to a legal case.
affiliation: Ferrogate Workers' Brotherhood (dissolved; he maintains its records unilaterally); The Shelf Residents' Association

decision_rules: Protect the people on your block first, ideology second
Document before you act — a claim without evidence is just noise
Never trust anyone who hasn't had something taken from them by someone more powerful
escalation_ladder: Direct honest statement of the problem
Formal documentation and escalation through whatever channels remain
Public noise — telling everyone who will listen
Physical intervention if someone on his block is in immediate danger

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Assesses them for about ninety seconds with visible skepticism before deciding whether to engage; will be gruffly helpful if they pass
interpersonal_modes.friends: Loyal with the uncomplicated ferocity of someone who has had friends die; checks in without being asked; shows up

stress_responses.low: Goes very quiet and very tidy; reorganizes the Brotherhood files
stress_responses.medium: Becomes clipped and tactical; starts asking very precise questions
stress_responses.high: Shifts into a calm that people who know him find more frightening than anger — he is planning

contradictions: Preaches collective action but has been operating as a solitary watchman for seven years because the collective was taken from him and he hasn't rebuilt it
habits: Checks the structural integrity of The Shelf's transit connection every morning out of professional habit
Keeps a handwritten log of every dispute he mediates
Touches the scar on his right knee before making a major decision
breaking_points: If someone on The Shelf is hurt in a transit accident he knew was coming, he will go to Ferrogate directly and publicly, consequences be damned

timeline.event: Born on The Shelf to a Serbian-Igbo-Pashtun family; father was a Ferrogate tunnel crew chief
Hired by Ferrogate Transit as a maintenance worker; follows his father into the tunnels
Elected shop steward for Block 7 crew
Becomes chief negotiator for the Ferrogate Workers' Brotherhood
Loses lower right leg in tunnel collapse; collapse later attributed to cost-cutting violations he had reported
Brotherhood dissolved in Ferrogate restructuring; two colleagues who resisted die in separate 'accidents'
Files report on compromised tunnel; report buried
Begins informal dispute mediation and neighborhood watch on The Shelf

carried_weapons: Street Custom 'Judas Cradle' Electrified Knuckle Frame

physical_description.heritage: South Asian (36.7%), Middle Eastern (25.3%), Northern European (17.2%), Pacific Islander (16.5%), and Eastern European (4.3%) ancestry—a complex diaspora blend. The genetic mosaic manifests in warm, multi-tonal skin with golden and olive undertones throughout. South Asian prominence in cheekbone structure and facial warmth; Middle Eastern definition in jaw and brow architecture; Pacific Islander radiance softening the overall complexion; Northern European lightness in eye undertones and skin luminosity; Eastern European influences subtle in facial plane geometry.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and thick-necked, muscle mass degraded but frame still substantial — a laborer's body that has refused to fully age out of usefulness
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, slightly rheumy at edges
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm weathered tan-bronze with golden-olive undertones, sun-darkened from decades of platform exposure. The blend creates a rich, complex tone: South Asian golden-brown as base, Middle Eastern olive mid-tones, Pacific Islander warmth, with Northern European lightness preventing sallowness—a genuinely integrated diaspora complexion rather than distinct regional traits.
physical_description.complexion: Deep facial lines around the eyes and mouth from decades of squinting in transit tunnels and sun exposure; grey stubble shadow despite daily shaving; full, precisely trimmed grey beard showing obsessive grooming care. Cheekbones carry South Asian prominence balanced against a jaw structure reflecting Middle Eastern geometry. Facial planes suggest Pacific Islander warmth; overall complexion integrates all heritage elements into unified golden-olive tones rather than contrasting features—the face of someone whose ancestors crossed continents and merged.
distinguishing_marks: Radiation scarring across scalp in faint white striations, visible under harsh light — legacy of 2183 Ferrogate tunnel collapse
Burn scar on left forearm (5cm x 3cm), pale and smooth — electrical contact injury from early career
Deep crease scar along right knee joint where prosthetic socket connects, partially hidden by pant leg
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Industrial-grade titanium-composite prosthetic right leg from knee down — utilitarian design with visible wear, scuff marks, and repaired plating; no cosmetic casing. Subdermal comms implant manifests as faint linear scar behind right ear and occasional light blue LED pulse when receiving messages (union-era tech, visibly dated).
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with military-straight posture despite age; walks with slight rightward lean compensating for prosthetic weight distribution; movements deliberate and economical, no wasted motion — the gait of someone who calculated efficiency for forty years. Hands often at rest position as if holding contract papers or taking notes.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 2-3 working class aesthetic, decades consistent: grey or black wool-blend utility trousers with reinforced knees, heavy canvas or synthetic jackets in muted colors (navy, charcoal), steel-toed boots (left pristine, right heavily scuffed to match prosthetic), a brass-linked watch that belonged to his father. Occasionally wears a faded embroidered Ferrogate Workers' Brotherhood vest — the only piece of clothing with color and sentiment. No corporate branding. Everything worn but maintained with fastidious care.
